testcase.name: jitter telemetry is only reported while Argon paces, and is never negative
a paced cap waits roughly one frame and does not run early
a cap change paces on the new interval instead of waiting out the old one
releasing the cap and taking it back paces from the first frame again
only a positive cap below 260 is paced
an interrupt is preserved across a paced wait instead of spinning the park loop
a stall longer than a frame is not caught up on
